what: Whether the eight works named on CLU-242 can be sourced as Matt Johnson directing credits. None of them was added to the list: its roster rule is a bare Director=Yes on his filmography, and none of the eight clears it.

how.wikipedia_fulltext: en.wikipedia.org action=query&list=search with insource:, which matches raw wikitext in ANY article, including passing mentions and red links
how.wikidata_item_search: wbsearchentities, which finds items that have no article at all
how.sparql: query.wikidata.org — every work with P57 (director) = Q25209047

items.title: Honolulu Blue
items.verdict: No trace. The title matches only Detroit Lions colour articles; requiring "Matt Johnson" as well returns nothing at all.

items.title: the other Operation Avalanche (an earlier short of the same name)
items.verdict: No trace of a second, earlier work of that name. Every hit is the 2016 feature's own festival and award coverage. The feature's article runs from conception straight into principal photography as his MFA thesis film and mentions no proof-of-concept short.

searches.query: insource:"Operation Avalanche" insource:"short film" insource:"Matt Johnson"
top_articles: Canadian Screen Award for Best Motion Picture

items.title: Nirvana the Band the Show Live @ the Rivoli
items.verdict: No trace. The hits are unrelated Rivoli venues and an Attila the Stockbroker album. The web series' article ends at eleven episodes, which is what this list already ships.

top_articles: List of terrorist incidents in France

items.title: Fantastic Corpse
items.verdict: No trace. One hit, a Brazilian film with a different title.

items.title: Matt Johnson Live at Comic-Con
items.verdict: No trace. The exact-title search is the only query in the sweep that returned zero hits of any kind.

items.title: the Mega64 special
items.verdict: Documented, but not as a directing credit. The only article naming both is Nirvanna the Band the Show, whose Online video collaborations section says he and Jay McCarrol APPEARED IN special shorts for 64X in September 2023 and again in September 2024. No director credit, no title of their own, no runtime.

items.title: the 64expo special
items.verdict: The same works as the Mega64 item, named twice: 64X IS Mega64's event, and two editions of it rather than two specials. "64expo" as a string appears in no article.

conclusion: Wikipedia's full text and Wikidata's item search return the same answer: seven of the eight have no machine-readable trace anywhere and no Wikidata item of their own. The eighth — the 64X shorts, one thing named twice — is documented as an appearance rather than a directing credit, which is the ground the Alvvays music video is already excluded on. Shipping them means widening the list's rule from "anything he directs" to "anything he directs or appears in", which also admits Anne at 13,000 Ft., Matt and Mara, The Heirloom, the Alvvays video and Joel Haver's 2026 short. That is the list owner's decision, not a generator's.
